title: remote: made CombinedCache a composition of Disk and Http Cache

timeline.body:
Fixes #8052 

The problem: CombinedCache is not working.
The cause: both `OnDiskBlobStore` and `HttpBlobStore` store action results differently from other actions, but not in the same way. The `OnDiskBlobStore` appends "ac_" prefix to the key, while the `HttpBlobStore` stores it in a different directory. Current implementation added "ac_" prefix for both blob stores, which is not correct for the `HttpBlobStore`.
The solution: treat actionResults' `gets` and `puts` in accordance with a particular Blob Store used.

The problem is described in #8052 and the root cause is described in [this](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/8052#issuecomment-483556888) and [this](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/8052#issuecomment-487068204) comments.
This part is intact - it's still the same logic with the only difference - it is called explicitly from the `getActionResult` method

Note, `OnDiskBlobStore` [applies a prefix to the key](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/fbeb0c9793e146d08c9d6dfdfceaea8b24f86e6c/src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/remote/blobstore/OnDiskBlobStore.java#L59-L63). So, this implementation would miss action cache items written by `OnDiskBlobStore`. That's the reason why the combined cache calls `super.getActionResult` and `bsHttp.getActionResult` separately.

reply.body: Right, I missed the prefix in this case... Thanks!

timeline.body: Same issue with `OnDiskBlobStore` action key prefix.

timeline.body: I don't understand what this buys us. The code is still closely tight to the local disk cache by having copied the move logic in `get`. I couldn't possibly plug in anything except the disk cache there?

reply.body: Right, it is quite tight to the local disk cache, but it has a modified not just copied logic. I'd say there is not much difference in this particular case, so I'd stay with composition (it is done already and did not take more than 2 minutes of implementation time ;)) .

@buchgr, PTAL.
I tried to merge DiskStore and CombinedDiskStore - it looked much more complex than it is now, because every method had to be there 3 times: 1 public, 1 private for actual interactions with disk store, 1 private for interactions with Remote Store. The class became big and not readable. So, i'd stay with the current solution.
